title: Methods for Studying Anthropogenic Hybridization in Marble Trout
author: Gianluca Polgar
materials: Anal fin clips were stored in 96% ethanol at 4°C. Whole genomic DNA was extracted and purified from the fin clips using a KingFisher Cell and Tissue DNA Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., Fremont, CA, USA), according to manufacturer protocols.

steps.title: Collect Fish Samples
steps.instruction: Collect fish samples from the specified locations using appropriate capture methods.

substeps.instruction: Collect hatchery-bred marble trouts (n=72) from the Caddo hatchery using a circular dip net (60 cm diameter) in a 1.5 m deep x 5 m diameter tank.
Collect wild-caught fish (n=27) from the middle and lower tracts of the Toce River using rod-and-line and electrofishing.

For electrofishing, use a built-in-frame EL64GII device (Scubla aquaculture, 3.5 KW, 600 V, DC current) with a copper cathode (2 cm width, 300 cm length) and a steel ring anode (0.8 cm thickness, 50 cm diameter).
Phenotypically select wild-caught fish based on the presence of marbled spots in their colouration pattern.

steps.title: Process and Measure Captured Fish
steps.instruction: Anaesthetize, measure, and photograph the collected fish.

substeps.instruction: Mildly anaesthetize fish using a 1:5 solution of clove oil in ethanol, adding 2 ml of this solution to 10 l of water.
Measure total length (TL) in cm to the nearest mm and wet body mass (W) in g to the nearest g.
Photograph each fish in lateral view.

steps.title: Amplify and Sequence Mitochondrial DNA
steps.instruction: Perform amplification and sequencing of the mitochondrial control region (D-loop).

substeps.instruction: Amplify the D-loop using LN20 and HN20 primers.
Perform Sanger sequencing using the LN20 primer on a 3130XL sequencer (Applied Biosystems).
Align partial d-loop sequences (531 bp) with GenBank references using BLASTN.
Assign sequences to one of the five major S. trutta complex mtDNA lineages.

steps.title: Genotype Nuclear Microsatellite Loci
steps.instruction: Genotype individuals at 15 nuclear microsatellite loci.

substeps.instruction: Amplify 15 nuclear microsatellite loci using 14 primer pairs.
Genotype the loci using a 3130XL sequencer (Applied Biosystems).
Score the genotypes using GeneMapper v.4.0 (Applied Biosystems).

steps.title: Analyze Genetic Relationships and Structure
steps.instruction: Perform computational analysis to determine genetic relationships, sibship, and population structure.

substeps.instruction: Investigate genetic relationships using factorial correspondence analysis (FCA) with GENETIX v.4.0.

Estimate full-sibship (FS) and half-sibship (HS) and the number of families using COLONY v.2.0.6.6 with a pairwise- and full-likelihood sibship reconstruction method (assume polygamous mating, allelic dropout rate= 0.0000, other error rate= 0.0001, and Excluded Maternal Sibship prior).
Estimate population genetic structure and introgression patterns using STRUCTURE v.2.3.3 (20 runs for K=1 to 10; 100,000 burn-in, 200,000 Markov chain steps, admixture model).
Estimate the most likely number of genetic clusters using the ΔK method and MedMed K, MedMean K, Max-Med K, and MaxMean K statistics via StructureSelector.
Obtain individual admixture proportions (q values) and 90% Bayesian credible intervals (BCI) using CLUMPAK.
Repeat STRUCTURE analysis (K=1-6) on a reduced dataset (TRUTg, Caddo, and Toce samples).
Build Neighbour-Joining (NJ) trees in STRUCTURE v.2.3.3 using the matrix of allele-frequency divergence.

steps.title: Score and Correlate Phenotypes
steps.instruction: Analyze fish colouration patterns and correlate them with genetic data.

substeps.instruction: Examine digital photos of individuals to observe colouration patterns of the head and body.
Filter for sexually mature individuals by including only those with TL ≥ 23.0 cm (Caddo) or TL ≥ 25.4 cm (Toce).
Code colouration patterns based on six types of spots, one preopercular blotch, and parr marks using the defined coding system (m, f, d, r, p, c, b, k), where 0 indicates absence.
Assign phenotypes: 'reference phenotype' (m00/m0000/0/0/0) or 'hybrid phenotype' (m**/m****/0/0/0, *** /m****/0/0/0, or m**/*****/0/0/0).
Ensure accuracy by having three different researchers code the patterns and re-examining to eliminate mismatches.
Convert coded colouration patterns and genetic data into numerical scores (0-1).
Perform a t-test to determine if the Pearson correlation between phenotypic and genotypic scores differs significantly from 0.
